name: Ray casting with on-the-fly region growing
definition: An extended ray casting scheme for 3-D navigation into heart cavities that eliminates artifacts due to contrast inhomogeneities during volume traversal by launching a local region growing algorithm when objects are detected, filtering out small 'particle-like' regions while preserving large endocardial walls.
summary: Ray casting with on-the-fly region growing filters small noise artifacts during volume rendering by growing detected regions and discarding those below a size threshold, preserving structural boundaries.
